headline: Cyclone Akvan: IMD Red Alert for 7 Andhra Districts, 19-20 Nov

image.licence: Public domain (NASA EOSDIS GIBS / Worldview imagery, US government work)
image.author: NASA Worldview / EOSDIS GIBS, MODIS on the Terra satellite, morning pass of 18 Nov 2026
image.subject: Cyclone Akvan's cloud mass and spiral bands over the Bay of Bengal off India's east coast (Andhra/Tamil Nadu coast at left), 18 Nov 2026; bbox 7-21N, 80-91.2E. New still: earlier Akvan covers used 15 and 16 Nov passes.

fact_sources.fact: Akvan intensified into a severe cyclonic storm; at 05:30 IST on 18 Nov it was near 12.7N/85.5E, about 610 km SE of Machilipatnam, moving north-northwest at 3 km/h
IMD: likely to cross Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon of 20 Nov as a severe cyclonic storm, 100-110 km/h gusting to 120 km/h
On Tuesday 17 Nov IMD had forecast a very severe cyclonic storm at landfall with gusts to 145 km/h (since revised)
Red alert for extremely heavy rain on 19-20 Nov for 7 Andhra districts: Kakinada, Konaseema, East Godavari, West Godavari, Eluru, Krishna, Bapatla (lists match exactly; DC also names Yanam)
IMD: isolated extremely heavy rainfall (21 cm or more) in coastal Andhra Pradesh on 19 and 20 Nov (basis of the red alert)

IMD storm surge warning: 0.4-1.2 m above astronomical tide in low-lying areas of Prakasam, Bapatla, Krishna, West Godavari, Konaseema, Kakinada and Visakhapatnam at landfall; peak over Bapatla, Krishna, West Godavari and Kakinada from 20 Nov morning to afternoon
13 NDRF and 11 SDRF teams on standby in Andhra Pradesh

not_used: Sakshi Post (district list) per G1 condition; Alluri/NTR/Palnadu orange upgrade (Sakshi only); very-severe forecast (superseded by IMD 18 Nov 09:30 bulletin). No Akvan school closures or train cancellations found as of ~12:35 IST.
